bio.text: Bill Foster has represented Illinois's 11th Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2013, and represented the 14th District from 2008 to 2011.
Before Congress he was a high-energy physicist at Fermilab, and he co-founded the theater lighting company Electronic Theatre Controls with his brother.
He serves on the Financial Services and Science, Space, and Technology committees and lives in Naperville.
